description: The restored view exposes original text, phonemes, tags, and token endpoints (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text Q $x(candidate) Y
%conditions text(without-elision($x)) = "x", phonemes(without-elision($x)) = "x", tags(without-elision($x)) = X, ¬initial(without-elision($x)), text(head(without-elision($x))) = "x", text(last(without-elision($x))) = "x", text(tail(without-elision($x))) = "", matches(after(without-elision($x)), following)
%rule candidate X [+T] <~private>
%rule following Y
